name: KeyToCose
description: Converts a Java key object, PEM string, or key pair struct to a COSE key struct (integer keys per RFC 9052). Supports EC (P-256, P-384, P-521) and Ed25519 keys.

params.name: key
params.description: Key to convert: PublicKey, PrivateKey, PEM string, or key pair struct from GenerateKeyPair()
